q1_issues.issue: The antecedentless "It" becomes sk_it_1, named after the pronoun rather than a class and with no typing atom, where the instruction set requires an sk_<class>_<n> witness plus its Member atom ("it" → the salient kind, else thing).
The definite plural "the views" is encoded as one singular witness (Member sk_view_1 view) instead of the group witness (GroupOf <group> view) the instruction set prescribes for a definite plural.
The ordinary type atoms that must accompany a multi-word name are missing: (Member republican_party party) and (Member free_soil_party party).

q2_gaps: two coordinated of-phrases sharing one head noun ("the views of A and of B") — the instruction set does not say whether the repeated preposition forces two distinct possessed sets rather than one symbol carrying two Possession links
notes: Theme for support, the Past atom, and the possessed-first Possession order are correct; the repeated "of" arguably marks two separate view sets, which the single sk_view_1 collapses.
